figures.caption: Selection: lexically first longest observed validation trajectory, based on history coverage not model errors. Missing observations are gaps, never zero.

Same preselected validation leaf. Forecast curves average predictions for visual clarity; all inferential metrics average per-seed errors, not ensemble forecasts. C0–C4 are Oracle organ-state conditions.

Negative differences favor real history. Independent unit: plant, 12 validation plants per split; errors averaged over three seeds then paired plant bootstrap (10,000 draws). Orange -0.5cm line is prespecified practical threshold; secondary tasks do not choose the branch. Fold training sets overlap.

Same history-coverage-selected validation plant; cumulative event labels include scans through target. Future IDs never enter model inputs. Displayed probability curves are seed means, not the locked per-seed threshold decisions.

Raw height quantile span is not official Height Maximum: no manual growth point, no semantic taproot removal or label-wise voxel reduction. Raw hull diameter also differs from official downsampled/excluded geometry. Ridge uses train-only calibration; no future correction.

Post-hoc highest validation primary MAE plant and organ; diagnostic only, never used to alter task/model/branch. Missing future targets are excluded from morphology metrics but remain in visibility assessment; full measurement trace is in outputs/m3_5/data/organ_trajectories.csv.
